posts.title: About myself
posts.snippet: All my years leading up-to my uni life, i thought i really want to study computer science, until at the last moment came to decide my engineering department in my uni i chose to pursue electronics and telecommunications,i have never regretted choosing to pursue this path, up until the 2nd year i was confused about choosing telecom or electronics as my career. Currently i'm in third year and i have fixed my mind about choosing the electronics path but still unsure whether i wanna do what in the electronics domain. Currently i am doing projects related to digital system design (FPGA) and PCB design. I am exploring other domains as well,i'm trying to get into some RF electronics as well such as doing PCB projects related to RF. I wanna test the waters with all the domains related to electronics then i will know what i really like doing.
